title: Little dragon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#1b3a1b'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 74 Q18 72 14 60 Q12 52 18 50 Q24 49 24 56 Q26 66 34 68 Z' fill='#2f8f3f'/>
  <path d='M18 52 L12 46 L16 58 Z' fill='#7ee07e'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2f8f3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#7ee07e'/>
  <!-- right leg dancing high -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='78' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2f8f3f'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='81' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#9cf09c'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#3fbf4f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#c8f7a0'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <path d='M34 58 Q20 48 22 62 Q24 72 36 68 Z' fill='#8ff08f'/>
  <path d='M66 58 Q80 48 78 62 Q76 72 64 68 Z' fill='#8ff08f'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3fbf4f' transform='rotate(-35 32 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3fbf4f' transform='rotate(35 68 56)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='15' fill='#3fbf4f'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8ff08f'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#1b5a1b'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#1b5a1b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='2' fill='#1b5a1b'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='2' fill='#1b5a1b'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 51 Q50 55 55 51' stroke='#1b5a1b' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M40 27 L37 18 L45 25 Z' fill='#ffd84d'/>
  <path d='M60 27 L63 18 L55 25 Z' fill='#ffd84d'/>
  <!-- spikes on head -->
  <path d='M50 24 L50 16 L55 24 Z' fill='#ff9c3d'/>
  <!-- little belly spikes -->
  <path d='M42 62 L38 64 L42 66 Z' fill='#ff9c3d'/>
  <path d='M58 62 L62 64 L58 66 Z' fill='#ff9c3d'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd84d'>
    <circle cx='84' cy='34' r='3'/>
    <rect x='85.5' y='22' width='2' height='12'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ff9c3d'>
    <circle cx='16' cy='40' r='2.5'/>
    <rect x='17' y='30' width='1.8' height='10'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M76 20 L78 24 L82 26 L78 28 L76 32 L74 28 L70 26 L74 24 Z' fill='#9cf0ff'/>
  <path d='M24 22 L25.5 25 L28.5 26.5 L25.5 28 L24 31 L22.5 28 L19.5 26.5 L22.5 25 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
